name: [[784,8,27]] two-step local reduction of planar tile code

provenance.construction: Two local reductions from codes/786-8-27.json. First XOR Z rows 126 and 148 to obtain support [548,568]; replace Z row 126 by that combination, clear qubit 548 from other Z rows, then delete row 126 and qubit 548, shortening X rows and deleting coordinate 548. In the resulting 785-qubit code, use X row 17 with support [0,20,394,409,410] to clear qubit 394 from other X rows; delete row 17 and qubit 394, shorten Z rows, and delete coordinate 394. At both steps renumber larger qubit indices down by one and retain the remaining row order.
provenance.notes: A two-row Z pivot followed by an X pivot lowers the published 786-qubit tile code to 784 qubits while retaining k=8, weight 8, one-layer radius 4, and explicit X-27 and Z-27 logicals. Distance remains a witness-backed upper bound.
